description: Rajasthan’s AI policy emphasises responsible adoption, administrative ownership and capability-building as it seeks a defined role nationally.
body_lead: Rajasthan’s decision to approve the AI & ML Policy–2026 is more than a routine policy announcement; it is a signal of intent. At a time when artificial intelligence is rapidly becoming central to governance, industry and geopolitics, the state is attempting to define its place in India’s AI story with clarity, structure and a distinctly public-purpose lens. For years, Rajasthan’s technology narrative has largely revolved around e-governance and digital inclusion.
